subject: Schedule Change Notification - $module_code: Date/Time Updated
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

This email is to inform you that there has been a change to the schedule for $module_code - $module_name.

=== Schedule Change Details ===

Change Type: Date/Time Change

Previous Schedule:
- Day: $old_day
- Time: $old_start_time - $old_end_time
- Room: $room_location
- Session Type: $session_type

New Schedule:
- Day: $new_day
- Time: $new_start_time - $new_end_time
- Room: $room_location
- Session Type: $session_type

Instructor: $instructor_name

=== Action Required ===

Please update your personal calendar and ensure you can attend at the new time. If you have any conflicts or concerns, please contact the module coordinator or academic office immediately.

=== Important Notes ===

- This change is effective immediately
- All students enrolled in this module are affected
- Please ensure you arrive at the correct time and location

If you have any questions or concerns about this schedule change, please contact:
- Module Coordinator: $coordinator_email
- Academic Office: academic.office@university.edu

Thank you for your understanding.

$signature
